review_notes: Under ‘Strengths’, the only comment was that ‘video materials aid learning’, with no mention of the case discussions. Whilst students were dissatisfied with the group assessment method, they did acknowledge the value of the case discussions themselves; these two assessments should be retained separately.

The main concern and cited evidence are supported, but “does not accommodate varying fitness levels” is more categorical than the students’ expressed preferences for greater consideration of fitness differences. This is scored as a loss of qualification under uncertainty_preserved, rather than a substantive error in issue coverage or citation support.
The abstract states that it ‘may affect grading comparability’; it does not assert that the grading criteria have already changed.
The general summary omits the qualification that the fairness of the marks is a matter of personal perception.
